'''D5-2D''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The D5-2D Astromech Droid was first added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Pursuer's Bounty Pack.<ref name="TOR" />

*[[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] {{1st}}
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]''
